name: oracle.locate
description: Find definitions of a symbol. Returns definitions[] and references_count.

kind.description: Optional kind filter (function, class, method, route, component, etc.)

name: oracle.signature
description: Get the signature, type info, and doc for a symbol or location.

name: oracle.exists
description: Search for something by description. Returns whether it exists and candidates.

name: oracle.nearby
description: Find symbols near a location in a file, ranked by proximity and intent.

name: oracle.consumers
description: Who uses a symbol: direct users with the exact call lines (method calls are resolved by receiver type, inheritance and imports), transitive users, callers reaching a method through the interface or parent it implements, its implementations, and possible call sites that static analysis could not bind (receiver of unknown type). `complete: false` means check possible_call_sites before concluding a symbol is unused.

kind.description: Optional filter on the edge kind (calls, imports, renders, references, injects, extends...) or the user's kind

name: oracle.diff_since
description: Show changed files and symbols since a git ref.

name: oracle.conventions_for
description: How the project does something: base types the topic's code extends, where it lives, route middleware (auth/routing), recurring patterns, documented rules and examples.

topic.description: Topic: auth, validation, errors, routing, state, migrations, testing, or any other word (logging, caching...)

name: oracle.where_would
description: Suggest the path for new code, learned from files of the same kind (controller, component, hook, migration...): the directory already used for that feature, the per-feature layout, or the main directory, named like its neighbours (prefix/suffix, timestamp, casing). Reports when the name already exists.

intent.description: What to create, kind of code first, e.g. "API controller for invoices", "reusable table component", "migration to add status to orders"

name: oracle.pattern
description: Look up a named pattern from the catalogue.

name: oracle.impact
description: Analyze impact of a proposed change. Returns breaking status, affected routes/components, migration needs, and for methods the callers through interfaces plus unresolved call sites to review.

change.description: Description of the change, e.g. "add status column to orders", "change signature of UserService::find"

name: oracle.validate
description: Validate proposed code against conventions and patterns.

path.description: File path for the proposed code

name: oracle.context
description: Bundled discovery — the primary tool. Returns full task packet: existing files, suggested creates/modifies, DB schema, patterns, conventions, relevant code.

name: oracle.read_exact
description: Read exact lines from a file. The only way to get verbatim code.

name: oracle.stats
description: Get node/edge counts by kind for debugging.

name: oracle.ingest
description: Ingest (build/rebuild) entity graph, patterns, manifest, contracts, L2 index, and markdown docs for a workspace or subproject.

subproject_id.description: Optional — ingests all subprojects if omitted

name: oracle.workspace_add
description: Register a new workspace by scanning a directory for subprojects. Pass `subprojects` to keep only some of them.

subprojects.description: Optional subproject ids (paths relative to the root, e.g. "backend") to register; re-scans keep this selection. Omit to register every detected subproject.

name: oracle.workspace_scan
description: Re-scan an existing workspace to detect new or removed subprojects.

subprojects.description: Optional new subproject selection; omit to keep the saved one, [] to select all.

name: oracle.workspace_list
description: List all registered workspaces and their subprojects.

name: oracle.status
description: Show layer status (L1/L2/L3), node/edge counts for workspaces and subprojects.

workspace_id.description: Optional — shows all workspaces if omitted

name: oracle.gate
description: Run emit gate (pre-commit validation) on a proposed diff. Checks: parse errors, conventions, impact, tests.

diff.description: Array of {path, content} objects representing the proposed changes

name: oracle.manifest_show
description: Show the manifest (framework, conventions, migrations, tests, etc.) for a subproject.

name: oracle.patterns_list
description: List all patterns in the pattern catalogue for a subproject.
